neutral_note: Norges Bank estimates the neutral real policy rate to be between 0.25% and 1.75% (MPR 3/2026).
output_gap_assessment: Slightly below normal, expected to bottom out in 2028.
rate_path_summary: Kept at 4.5% for a time, then reduced gradually from the end of 2027 to just below 3.5% towards the end of the projection period.
